verdict.rationale: Figma Make is an AI app builder, so letting an external coding agent drive it is a fair question. The evidence shows no way to connect your own agent. MCP support only pulls external tools in as context for the built-in agent (client-side), and manual code editing is a different feature. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, so users had to reverse-engineer the format just to extract code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one
